correctness.rationale: The exact 90-facet complex reconstructs f=(12,63,192,225,90). Unimodular reduction of d2 gives a primitive rank-140 integral 2-cycle lattice, and unimodular reduction of d3 inside that lattice gives a primitive rank-136 boundary lattice, proving H2=Z^4. Every four-set is exhausted; exactly 153 induced tetrahedral spheres are homologically nonzero, all with primitive integral coordinate vectors. Their integral sign-class counts, mod-two reductions, and the complementary-plane multiplicity rule are checked exactly.

value.rationale: Minimum vertex support for nonzero middle homology is a natural combinatorial systolic invariant of a small four-manifold triangulation. The result completely resolves the first possible support layer, proves all 153 carriers primitive, and reveals a strong mod-two organization: complementary planes separate three low-multiplicity classes from three absent classes, with all nine mixed classes occurring uniformly sixteen times. This structure is invisible from the known f-vector and H2 rank alone.
